        constraints = []

                x - r,  # x >= r
                1 - x - r,  # 1 - x >= r
                y - r,  # y >= r
                1 - y - r   # 1 - y >= r
            ])
        return np.array(constraints)

        # Ensure no two circles overlap
        constraints = []
        for i in range(n):
